# Marketic

> White-label marketing strategy brain: probability-calibrated market signals, ensemble AI voting with full audit trails, margin-aware budgets, and self-contained briefs that execution agents consume without calling back. Exposed as an MCP server with 39 tools.

Core claim: signals are scored `volume × P(YES)` because 73.4% of Polymarket markets resolve No — raw volume overweights drama. Budgets optimize `roas × contribution_margin`, not vanity ROAS. Every AI decision is logged with model, cost, confidence, and reasoning chain.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Das-rebel/marketic && cd marketic
pip install -e .
python3 init_memory_db.py
python3 daily_briefing.py "your topic"
```

## Key modules

- [signals/collectors.py](signals/collectors.py): parallel fan-out across Polymarket, Hacker News, Reddit, X, Product Hunt
- [ensemble/voting.py](ensemble/voting.py): confidence-weighted multi-model voting
- [ensemble/audit_trail.py](ensemble/audit_trail.py): SQLite audit log per AI decision
- [campaign/budget_router.py](campaign/budget_router.py): margin-adjusted budget allocation
- [gtm/ad_analysis.py](gtm/ad_analysis.py): VLM competitor ad deconstruction (local Ollama → cloud → heuristics)
- [execution/brief.py](execution/brief.py): generate_brief — the agent handoff artifact
- [execution/design_templates.py](execution/design_templates.py): BrandTokens — brand identity as data
